lock.title: Attendance periods
lock.description: Each pay period's attendance and leave lock when payroll is calculated, or earlier when HR asks after the cut-off date and someone else approves. A locked period never changes: a later correction is an adjustment carried into the next open payroll period.
lock.denied: You may not see attendance periods.
lock.loadError: The attendance periods could not be loaded.
lock.empty: No pay periods have started yet
lock.empty.body: Set up a pay group and generate its periods in the payroll calendar first.
lock.detail.title: Period {period} of {group}
lock.detail.openItems: {days} employee days not processed and {exceptions} open exceptions.
lock.detail.accepted: The lock accepted {days} employee days not processed and {exceptions} open exceptions.
lock.reopen: Ask to cancel the run and reopen
lock.late.title: Punches received after the lock
lock.late.none: No punch arrived for this period after it was locked.
lock.late.count: {count} punches arrived after the lock. They are kept and are not worked into the locked days; ask for an adjustment where they matter.
lock.lockForm.title: Ask to lock period {period} of {group}
lock.lockForm.explain: Someone else approves the lock. From then on nobody changes the period's attendance and leave.
lock.lockForm.accept: Lock with {days} employee days not processed and {exceptions} open exceptions
lock.reopenForm.title: Reopen period {period} of {group}
lock.reopenForm.explain: The payroll run that locked the period is cancelled and the period opens again, once someone else approves. A run that is locked, and a lock made by HR, never reopen.
lock.error.generic: The request could not be sent.
adj.title: Attendance adjustments
adj.description: Corrections of locked days. The locked days stay as payroll read them; an approved adjustment is carried into the next open payroll period.
adj.denied: You may not see attendance adjustments.
adj.loadError: The adjustments could not be loaded.
adj.empty.body: An adjustment is asked for when a locked day needs a correction.

adj.form.title: New adjustment
adj.form.leave.none: This employee has no approved leave.
